primaryChecks.text: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

context.text: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

primaryChecks.text: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

context.text: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

primaryChecks.text: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
